scope: Publish 14.1 stat-migration tables, server-owned allocation sessions, free fresh-character tutorial migration, first-planet admission retirement, authenticated entertainer-salon commit, and retained client command protocol.

semanticReference.purpose: Behavioral reference for nine-attribute bounds, totals, and server-authoritative migration validation.

commitBoundaries.tutorial: Validated targets are applied immediately and consumed once while either authoritative fresh-character tutorial marker remains present, covering both full and skipped starting halls without a tent.
commitBoundaries.firstPlanet: The full and skipped tutorial flows retire their markers at confirmed normal-world handoff; returning to the tutorial scene later does not restore free migration.
commitBoundaries.normalWorld: Validated targets remain server-owned until an authenticated, non-self entertainer with the imagedesign command commits them while both players remain in the same permanent salon or entertainment-module camp.

venueAdmission.permanentSalon: The exact session terminal has the salon object variable and remains the topmost container for both players.
venueAdmission.entertainerTent: The exact session terminal has modules.entertainer and its campsite trigger volume still contains both players at validation and commit time.

requirements: exact designer, recipient, terminal, and starting-time identity
recipient is no longer in the fresh-character tutorial lifecycle
both participants remain in the original server-verified salon structure or entertainment-module campsite trigger volume
recipient has a valid zero-points-left nine-stat allocation
imageDesignerCommit.consumption: The allocation is revalidated immediately before mutation and erased after one successful commit.
imageDesignerCommit.rewardGuard: DT_STAT_MIGRATION enters the 2,000 XP reward path even when no cosmetic hair, morph, index, or holo-emote field changed.
imageDesignerCommit.rewardRouting: The completion script grants directly to the dedicated imagedesigner pool; the NGE social-style template router is intentionally bypassed.

wireCompatibility.startingTime: Signed 32-bit retail-era epoch field, explicitly encoded independent of host time_t width.
wireCompatibility.liveFinding: An x64 Windows client writing raw 64-bit time_t shifts the remaining controller payload and is rejected by the 32-bit game server as an invalid network stream.

persistentSession.storage: Recipient creature object variables under precu.statMigration.
persistentSession.record: A nine-integer targets vector followed by a pending state marker written last.
persistentSession.recovery: The authoritative game server reloads and revalidates the record when no process-local session exists.
persistentSession.consumption: A committing marker is persisted before mutation; successful tutorial and salon commits remove the complete record.
persistentSession.failurePolicy: Partial, invalid, or interrupted-commit records fail closed and are never replayed.

ctsAllocation.source: validated unmodified maximum attributes in canonical nine-attribute order
ctsAllocation.destination: one native validation and application call before transfer flags or any skill, XP, quest, credit, waypoint, or item replay

knownLimitations.imageDesignerCommit: Restored for authenticated normal-world salon and entertainment-module camp transactions.
knownLimitations.sessionPersistence: Validated pending allocations survive a graceful game-server restart; an interruption after the committing marker is written fails closed rather than replaying the service.
